caption:
One fork wedged the drawer

The drawer stuck halfway all week. One fork had wedged the lid, and out it came.

A drawer that sticks usually has one small thing in the way, and finding it takes ten seconds.

For whoever takes out what is jamming the drawer instead of forcing it.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a counter on the right and a drawer in it that is stuck halfway open, with a silver fork wedged across the opening. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the fork lifts out and lands standing on the counter at the left while the drawer slides shut. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, finding what's stuck.
